prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: 1024x1024 marketplace plugin icon
Purpose: building, debugging, profiling, testing, refactoring, and releasing Swift apps across Apple platforms.
Literal semantic hero: an original swift bird in flight. It communicates fast, expressive Swift application development.
Silhouette: one luminous long-winged bird sweeping upward across the foreground. Use exactly one subordinate support cue: one orange code editor with braces, meaning hands-on application building, debugging, and release work.
Composition: one centered dominant silhouette, full-bleed opaque background, meaningful content inside the central 72 percent, no more than one support cue.
Small-size requirement: the bird-and-editor relationship must remain recognizable at 64, 32, 24, and 16 pixels; preserve the bird's long wing sweep and editor frame at 24 pixels.
Style: polished modern bitmap app icon, bold filled shapes, crisp edges, restrained dimensional polish, consistent portfolio weight.
Background: deep charcoal field anchored on #202028 with a restrained ember glow.
Foreground palette: luminous warm ivory bird, vivid ember orange editor, warm ivory braces, and restrained cyan highlights; meaningful adjacent colors meet at least 3:1 contrast.
Brand-source rule: brand-adjacent to Apple platforms and Swift only by domain; use original generated bird geometry and do not reproduce exact Apple Swift logo geometry, the Apple logo, Xcode application icon, Xcode hammer, or distinctive vendor trade dress.
Avoid: exact Apple Swift logo geometry; Apple logo; Xcode application icon; Xcode hammer; device collage; vendor-specific toolbar or UI replica.
Collision avoid: exact Apple Swift logo silhouette; generic code editor logo; bird-only social or messaging product icon.
Text: none. No letters, words, numbers, watermark, screenshot, photo, UI replica, tiny badge, thin-line detail, mascot, or private identifier.
checks: save the selected image as a 1024x1024 opaque RGB PNG at assets/icon.png
inspect semantic recognition and the monochrome silhouette at 16, 24, 32, and 64 px
reject a competing second cue, closed critical gap, portfolio collision, text, screenshot, photo, watermark, or low contrast
verify brand-source, trademark, license, and authorization provenance manually
wire identical interface.composerIcon and interface.logo paths plus interface.brandColor
